meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码改动变成讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要向团队讲解代码改动
copy.tagline_en: Turn code changes into an explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain code changes to others

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 能把 GitHub 上的一次 Pull Request(PR)变成讲解视频:先读取该 PR 的改动、提交记录和文件,再写出分镜与解说词,逐帧生成画面,最后渲染成 MP4 视频文件。
howto.when: 当你给出一个 GitHub PR 的链接、以 owner/repo#编号 引用它,或在本地代码仓库中说“这个 PR”,并要求把这段代码改动做成讲解视频时触发;意图不确定时改走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 帮我把 owner/repo#123 的改动做成一支讲解视频。
say.note: 它会读取该 PR 并开始制作视频。

say.text: 当前项目里的这个 PR,做成修复说明风格的视频。
say.note: 会以“修复说明”的讲法来组织内容。

say.text: 把 owner/repo#456 的改动做成变更日志式的视频。
say.note: 会按“变更日志”的叙事风格来生成。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude turns a GitHub pull request into an explainer video: it fetches the PR's diff, commits and files, writes a storyboard and script, builds frames, and renders an MP4 video file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you give a GitHub PR link, reference it as owner/repo#N, or say "this PR" in a local checked-out repo, and ask for a video explaining that code change. If unclear, the route switches to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn the changes in owner/repo#123 into an explainer video.
say_en.note: Reads that PR and starts building the video.

say_en.text: Make a 'fix explainer' video for this PR in the current project.
say_en.note: Tells the video as a fix walkthrough.

say_en.text: Create a changelog-style video for the changes in owner/repo#456.
say_en.note: Frames the content as a changelog.
